name: Diethanolamine
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: Tmin raised to the triple point 301.15 K (ChemSep: 283.15 K). A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 105.1356 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 301.15-736.60 K
